entries.name: Human
entries.description: The registered living of the Warrens. No gift but adaptability: humans learn faster from what tries to kill them.

entries.name: Revenant
entries.description: One of the catalogued dead who refused the record. Hard to kill twice, slow to mend: healing works at half strength.

entries.name: Cambion
entries.description: Born of a contract signed beneath the Geometry. Their blows find the gaps in any armor.
